caveats: The Q4 value is derived, not reported directly. It is the full-year cost of goods and services sold (26,487,000,000) less the nine-month year-to-date figure (20,908,000,000). The evidence states that these inputs reproduce the value.

claims.text: Nike's cost of revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-03-01 to 2026-05-31) was about $5.579 billion. It is derived as FY2026 cost of $26.487 billion minus the nine-month figure of $20.908 billion.

raw_output.summary: Nike's cost of revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (March 1 to May 31, 2026) was about $5.579 billion. This is a derived figure: full-year cost of revenue less the nine-month year-to-date amount.
